answer: Opt-in: committing throughout is a setting a project turns on; R-adf-1 and G0 are not amended.
effect: With no setting, orbit commits only as it does today: in a project that turns pull requests on, when a change is proposed, when it is archived and when work is handed to another reviewer, and in a project that sets nothing, never. The user turns committing throughout on in each of their own projects.
